summary: A minimal, production-ready C# console application targeting .NET Framework 4.7.2, serving as a foundational template for legacy .NET workflows with standardized Visual Studio architecture and MSBuild configuration.
achievements: Configured legacy MSBuild project structure with explicit framework references and build configurations. Implemented deterministic builds to ensure reproducible compilation outputs across different environments. Established proper assembly metadata management and runtime configuration hooks following traditional .NET Framework conventions, creating a reliable reference template for legacy system development.
